rules.name: xoga713-var-producer-check
rules.sql: SELECT upper(business_unit) AS business_unit, tenant_id, value_date, count(*) AS row_count, min(created_timestamp) AS first_written, max(created_timestamp) AS last_written, count(DISTINCT run_id) AS runs FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table GROUP BY upper(business_unit), tenant_id, value_date ORDER BY 1, 3

SELECT upper(business_unit) AS business_unit, coalesce(created_by, '-') AS created_by, min(value_date) AS first_date, max(value_date) AS last_date, count(*) AS row_count, max(created_timestamp) AS last_written FROM opera.var_accounting_table GROUP BY upper(business_unit), coalesce(created_by, '-') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view) AS view_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table) AS cache_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT upper(business_unit)) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table) AS business_units_in_cache

expect.reason: if the cache holds several business units, the engine (no business unit filter) writes ALL of them under the requested business unit
